pTheme: The theme name, as text: neutral, light, dark, vibrant, pro, access, print, gray, lightgray or darkgray; an unknown name is ignored.
pNotation: A notation, as the name of a registered notation or as a notation object; an unknown name leaves the default notation in force.
pLayout: A direction, :TopDown, :BottomUp, :LeftRight or :RightLeft (or tb, bt, lr, rl), or a graphviz engine such as dot or neato; anything else raises an error.
pStyle: The edge style, as text such as "dashed"; kept in lowercase without a check.
pColor: A colour: a name such as red, a semantic name such as success, a name with a shade mark such as blue+, or a #rrggbb code.
pFont: A font family name, as text, kept in lowercase.
pcColor: A colour: a name such as blue--, a semantic name or a #rrggbb code.
pcId: The node id, as text; it is folded to lowercase and is also the label.
pcTag: A tag, as text, as found in a node's :tags list.
pcNode: A node id, as text; case is ignored.
pcKind: A kind, as text; case is ignored.
paOptions: The options as a list of [ name, value ] pairs, such as [ [ "width", 1000 ] ].
pcFileName: The path of the file, as text.
pcFilename: The path of the file, as text.
pFilename: The path of the file to write, as text.
cDiagString: The text of a diagram in the .stzdiag format, as stzdiag writes it.
poDiagram: The stzDiagram to convert; anything else raises an error.
_cColor_: A colour: a name, a semantic name such as success, or a #rrggbb code.
_cTheme_: A theme name, as text; case matters.
pBgColor: The background colour, as a name or a #rrggbb code.
acNodeIds: The ids of the nodes to give the focus colour, as a list of text.
pClusterId: The cluster id, as text; it is also the label.
aNodeIds: The ids of the nodes the cluster holds, as a list of text; they are not checked.
oTemplate: A template object that has an Apply method taking the diagram.
pcRuleName: The name of the rule, as text.
paDefinition: The rule, as a hash list [ :conditionType, :conditionParams, :effects ]; conditionType is property_range, property_equals, property_exists or tag_exists.
pnX: The horizontal position, in pixels of the last picture.
pnY: The vertical position, in pixels of the last picture.
pnTol: The reach around the point, in pixels.
pcTitle: The title, as text, stored as given.
pcSubtitle: The subtitle, as text, stored as given.
